text:
alex: odd edge-case hitting in samples: emulator (api 29) + Retrofit streaming request + Authenticator -> intermittent `STREAM_CLOSED` / SSLHandshake during redirect. physical device fine. :thinking_face:

alex: minimal repro uses a non-rewindable RequestBody + Authenticator that calls `refreshToken()` (network). If emulator drops the pooled connection mid-redirect, refresh blocks and cause stream closure.

jonah: thanks for the repro. Did you try using a dedicated client for refresh? e.g.```kotlin
val authClient = OkHttpClient.Builder()
  .connectionPool(ConnectionPool(0, 1, TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS))
  .retryOnConnectionFailure(false)
  .callTimeout(Duration.ofSeconds(30))
  .build()
```
Use that inside the Authenticator instead of the main client.

alex: tried that — failure rate drops a lot but still see occasional `unexpected end of stream` when redirect + large body.

sanjay: two more ideas: 1) mark streaming uploads as non-replayable so SDK retry is skipped (we should detect this automatically), 2) add small jittered backoff before retry to let the emulator TCP stack settle.

marta: for DX we should add a FAQ entry: "Why do I see STREAM_CLOSED on Android emulator?" with recommended fixes: adb reverse for dev, dedicated auth client w/o pooling, avoid blocking network calls in Authenticator, and mark non-replayable requests. Also add a tiny sample in samples/android showing `BufferedRequestBody` and the `authClient` snippet.

alex: added a tiny branch `alex/emulator-auth-edge` in samples with the authClient + a note. Pushed but internal. CI will run emulator matrix.

ciara-bot: CI queued for alex/emulator-auth-edge : emulator (api26, api29) tests starting.

jonah: small SDK PR suggestion: change default retry logic to only auto-retry if `Request.tag(Replayable::class.java) == true` or method is idempotent. Emit a debug log when skipping retry due to non-replayable body.

sanjay: agree — keep default conservative. Add an opt-in flag `allowRetryForStreaming` default false. Also add unit tests that run in emulator CI to catch regressions.

marta: I'll create the docs PR and add the FAQ bullets + sample link. If CI reproducer is flaky we can mark it as flaky for now.

alex: assigning myself to follow up with SDK PR + samples + docs. Will update thread when PRs land. :thumbsup:
